installedFunction.equivalenceMethod: Hash pg_proc.prosrc after CRLF/lone-CR to LF conversion and removal of boundary ASCII whitespace bytes 0x09-0x0d and 0x20; preserve internal bytes, perform no Unicode normalization, then SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes. The earlier 5df6... digest retained one trailing LF; removing both delimiter-boundary newlines produces c409... without changing internal function text. pg_get_functiondef is diagnostic reconstructed SQL and is not equivalence evidence.
